findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Ker.lean:244-245`: `@[to_additive (attr := simp)] theorem mem_ker {f : G →* M} {x : G} : x ∈ f.ker ↔ f x = 1` — membership is rewritten to the value form by default-priority simp, which is why `high` was needed here.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem spinToSpecialOrthogonal_negOneSpin : spinToSpecialOrthogonal Q (negOneSpin Q hQ) = 1` (the proof body at lines 346-353 already establishes it) and derive the membership statement from it via `MonoidHom.mem_ker`, dropping the `high` priority.
findings.issue: `@[simp high]` on `negOneSpin_mem_ker_spinToSpecialOrthogonal` exists only to preempt Mathlib's simp-normal form for kernel membership; the lemma simp actually wants, `spinToSpecialOrthogonal Q (negOneSpin Q hQ) = 1`, is absent, so a user reasoning about the map's value (not membership) has no lemma at all.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn "negOne" TauCeti/` returns only `neg_one_mem_spinGroup`, `negOneSpin`, `coe_negOneSpin`, `negOneSpin_mem_ker_spinToSpecialOrthogonal` — no inequality lemma; the argument appears only at Kernel.lean:393-404.
findings.fix: State `theorem negOneSpin_ne_one (Q) [Invertible (2 : K)] [Nontrivial M] (hQ : Q.Nondegenerate) : negOneSpin Q hQ ≠ 1` in the `NegOne` section (it needs no `FiniteDimensional`) and use it in `card_ker_spinToSpecialOrthogonal`.
findings.issue: `negOneSpin Q hQ ≠ 1` is proven inline (lines 393-404, an `algebraMap_injective` plus `Invertible.ne_zero (2 : K)` argument) instead of being exposed. It is the characteristic fact distinguishing the two kernel elements, needed by the stated downstream product (the `1 → ℤ/2 → Spin → SO → 1` sequence, `orderOf (negOneSpin ..) = 2`), and a consumer must redo the whole argument.

findings.evidence: Kernel.lean:220 and 235 are `private theorem`; `grep -rn "contractLeft" TauCeti/` shows a public contraction API in `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Filtration.lean:557,568`, and the repo has no other statement of the even-center fact (`grep -rn "Commute.*ι Q"` hits only this file).
findings.fix: Make these two public (keeping the exterior-basis and `coordinateProjector` helpers private); they complement the already-public contraction API in `Filtration.lean` (`contractLeft_mem_filtration`).
findings.issue: `eq_algebraMap_of_mem_even_of_commute` (an even Clifford element commuting with every `ι Q v` is scalar — the center computation of Lawson–Michelsohn I §2) and its companion `eq_algebraMap_of_contractLeft_eq_zero` (line 220: all contractions vanish ⇒ scalar) are general Clifford-algebra results independent of the Spin group, kept `private` and thus unusable by any other file.

summary: The `negOneSpin` surface is missing two characteristic facts — `negOneSpin ≠ 1` (proven inline inside the cardinality proof) and the map-value lemma `spinToSpecialOrthogonal Q (negOneSpin Q hQ) = 1`, whose absence is patched with a `@[simp high]` priority hack against Mathlib's `MonoidHom.mem_ker` normal form. The file's general Clifford results (an even element commuting with all vectors is scalar) are also locked behind `private`.
